verses.1: For the leader. A psalm of David.
verses.2: The LORD answer you in time of distress; the name of the God of Jacob defend you!
verses.3: May God send you help from the temple, from Zion be your support.
verses.4: May God remember your every offering, graciously accept your holocaust, Selah
verses.5: Grant what is in your heart, fulfill your every plan.
verses.6: May we shout for joy at your victory, raise the banners in the name of our God. The LORD grant your every prayer!
verses.7: Now I know victory is given to the anointed of the LORD. God will answer him from the holy heavens with a strong arm that brings victory.
verses.8: Some rely on chariots, others on horses, but we on the name of the LORD our God.
verses.9: They collapse and fall, but we stand strong and firm.
verses.10: LORD, grant victory to the king; answer when we call upon you.

notes.text: Remember: God's remembering implies readiness to act. Cf Genesis 8:1; Exodus 2:24
Victory: the Hebrew root is often translated "salvation," "to save," but in military contexts it can have the specific meaning of "victory."
